[EN] The Brogar Legion are the worst fiends I've ever seen. Brutal and cunning, they're slaughtering our troops.

If we could just blunt their offensive for a while, we could take the initiative and counterattack.
[ES] La Brogar Legion es la peor caterva de monstruos que he visto en mi vida. Brutos y astutos, están masacrando a nuestras tropas.

Si tan solo pudiera frenar su ofensiva por un momento, podríamos tomar la iniciativa y contraatacar.
